preconditions.description: The integer n must be between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(permutation) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation)
preconditions.description: The permutation must contain exactly n integers, each between 1 and n.
All integers in the permutation must be unique.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'ambiguous' if permutation == inverse_permutation else 'not ambiguous'
postconditions.description: The output must indicate whether the permutation is ambiguous or not based on its comparison with the inverse permutation.
